Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how American Shingle Co. ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and shares personal information when you visit 1-stop-roofing.com or use our telephone referral service.

1. Information We Collect

When you submit an estimate request or contact our phone intake, we collect personal contact information necessary to connect you with a local contractor:

  • Contact Details: Your name, phone number, email address, and property postal ZIP code.
  • Project Details: Project scope (roof replacement, new installation, storm inspection) and material preferences.
  • Technical Information: IP address, device type, browser specifications, and referring URL collected automatically via server access logs.

2. How We Use and Share Your Information

We use the information you submit solely to fulfill your request for roofing estimates. By submitting a quote form or calling our phone number, you authorize us to transmit your contact details and project specifications to participating independent roofing contractors serving your immediate geographic market.

We do not sell your personal information to third-party telemarketers or unrelated promotional aggregators.

3. TCPA & Communications Consent

By submitting your telephone number on our forms, you provide express written consent for American Shingle Co. and its matched partner roofing contractors to contact you via telephone call or SMS text message at the number provided, including through the use of automated dialing technology. You understand that consent is not a required condition of purchasing goods or services. You may revoke consent at any time by replying STOP to any text message.

4. Your Data Protection Rights (CCPA / CPRA)

Residents of California and other states with comprehensive data protection laws have the right to request access to, deletion of, or correction of personal information held in our records. To exercise your rights, email your request to privacy@1-stop-roofing.com.

Referral Network & Legal Disclaimer: American Shingle Co. is a nationwide consumer referral and matching service. We are not a direct roofing contractor and do not perform roofing construction services ourselves. All roofing estimates, inspections, contracts, warranties, and permits are provided directly by independent, third-party licensed and insured roofing contractors in our referral network.

Contractor credentials, licensing numbers, and insurance coverage vary by state and local jurisdiction and are verified in accordance with state and municipal regulatory requirements. Always verify your fulfilling contractor's local license and permit documentation prior to contracting work.
